basic_info.description: An exceptional opportunity to own three classic Russian Hill flats, two of which are currently vacant, offering endless possibilities for investment or personal use. Nestled in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods, this distinguished property boasts a charming and secluded backyard, perfect for relaxation and entertaining. Ideally situated just blocks from the vibrant Upper Polk Street, enjoy the convenience of world-class dining, boutique shopping, and easy access to public transportation. A rare gem in a premier location; don't miss this extraordinary offering.  There is no parking.
